title: The Rosary of the Holy Wounds
description: Chaplet of the Holy Wounds for reparation and mercy · ~10 min

steps.versicle: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.
steps.title: Sign of the Cross
The Sacred Wound of the Left Foot — the Offering on the large bead
Ten times, on the small beads
The Sacred Wound of the Right Foot — the Offering on the large bead
Ten times, on the small beads
The Sacred Wound of the Left Hand — the Offering on the large bead
Ten times, on the small beads
The Sacred Wound of the Right Hand — the Offering on the large bead
Ten times, on the small beads
The Sacred Wound of the Side and Heart — the Offering on the large bead
Ten times, on the small beads

hw_o_jesus.text: O Jesus, divine Redeemer, be merciful to us and to the whole world. Amen.
hw_o_jesus.source: The Rosary of the Holy Wounds (revealed to Sister Mary-Martha Chambon of the Visitation, d. 1907; approved for the Visitation 1912 and for the faithful 1924; received pre-1930 redaction)

hw_trisagion.text: Strong God, holy God, immortal God, have mercy on us and on the whole world. Amen.
hw_trisagion.source: The Rosary of the Holy Wounds (revealed to Sister Mary-Martha Chambon of the Visitation, d. 1907; approved for the Visitation 1912 and for the faithful 1924; received pre-1930 redaction)

hw_grace_and_mercy.text: Grace and mercy, O my Jesus, during present dangers; cover us with Thy precious Blood. Amen.
hw_grace_and_mercy.source: The Rosary of the Holy Wounds (revealed to Sister Mary-Martha Chambon of the Visitation, d. 1907; approved for the Visitation 1912 and for the faithful 1924; received pre-1930 redaction)

hw_mercy_through_blood.text: Eternal Father, grant us mercy through the Blood of Jesus Christ, Thy only Son; grant us mercy, we beseech Thee. Amen. Amen. Amen.
hw_mercy_through_blood.source: The Rosary of the Holy Wounds (revealed to Sister Mary-Martha Chambon of the Visitation, d. 1907; approved for the Visitation 1912 and for the faithful 1924; received pre-1930 redaction)

hw_offering.text: Eternal Father, I offer Thee the Wounds of Our Lord Jesus Christ, to heal those of our souls.
hw_offering.source: The Rosary of the Holy Wounds (revealed to Sister Mary-Martha Chambon of the Visitation, d. 1907; approved for the Visitation 1912 and for the faithful 1924; received pre-1930 redaction)

hw_mercy.text: My Jesus, pardon and mercy, by the merits of Thy holy Wounds.
hw_mercy.source: The Rosary of the Holy Wounds (revealed to Sister Mary-Martha Chambon of the Visitation, d. 1907; approved for the Visitation 1912 and for the faithful 1924; received pre-1930 redaction)

glory_be.text:
Glory be to the Father,
and to the Son,
and to the Holy Spirit,
as it was in the beginning,
is now, and ever shall be,
world without end.
Amen.
glory_be.latin:
Gloria Patri, et Filio,
et Spiritui Sancto,
sicut erat in principio,
et nunc, et semper,
et in saecula saeculorum.
Amen.

schedule_note.note: The Rosary of the Holy Wounds (Chaplet of Mercy) of Sister Mary-Martha Chambon in the received form: "O Jesus, divine Redeemer…" on the crucifix; the three opening invocations on the pendant; then five groups, each the Offering ("Eternal Father, I offer Thee the Wounds…") for the large bead and the aspiration "My Jesus, pardon and mercy, by the merits of Thy holy Wounds." ten times for the small beads, one wound per group (feet, hands, then the side — the nailing order, followed by the Lance); closing with the Offering three times and the Glory Be. The tasking’s suggested 39-group recension is not supported by any source this pack could verify, so the received 5-wound form ships and is documented here. The counted small beads carry the "My Jesus" aspiration, not the Hail Mary, so each group is modeled as the offering prayer plus a repetition step of ten — the engine’s counted-target step whose text is the aspiration itself. Fridays are the devotion’s traditional day; the pack is available daily at 13:00.
schedule_note.structure: sign of the cross; crucifix prayer; 3 opening invocations; 5 groups of (the Offering + 10x "My Jesus, pardon and mercy"); the Offering 3x; Glory Be
